spec.description: Combined digital humidity, pressure and temperature sensor from Bosch Sensortec with I2C and SPI interfaces and on-chip compensation coefficients.

pins.note: Interface supply for the digital I/O.
I2C data (SDA). Board default. Most breakouts include 10 kΩ pull-ups.
Tie high to select I2C mode; must not be pulled low once I2C is in use.
Sets I2C address LSB: GND = 0x76, VDDIO = 0x77. Do not leave floating.

warnings: The BME280 is a 3.3 V device: never connect VDD or any signal to 5 V.
The SDO pin selects the I2C address (GND → 0x76, VDDIO → 0x77) and must not be left floating.
Humidity settings in ctrl_hum only take effect after the next write to ctrl_meas.
In normal mode with these settings the sensor updates once per second; read all 8 data registers in one burst to avoid mixing samples.
